translation_en: In the Name of Allah, the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful
All praise is due to Allah, Lord of the worlds
The Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful
Sovereign of the Day of Recompense
It is You we worship and You we ask for help
Guide us to the straight path
The path of those upon whom You have bestowed favor
Not of those who have evoked anger or of those who are astray
Say, He is Allah, the One
Allah, the Eternal Refuge
He neither begets nor is born

translit: wa lam yakun lahu kufuwan a7ad
translation_en: Nor is there to Him any equivalent
Say, I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak
From the evil of that which He created

translit: wa min sharri ghasiqin idha waqab
translation_en: And from the evil of darkness when it settles

translit: wa min sharri al-naffathati fi al-3uqad
translation_en: And from the evil of the blowers in knots
And from the evil of an envier when he envies
Say, I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind
The Sovereign of mankind
The God of mankind
From the evil of the retreating whisperer
Who whispers into the breasts of mankind
From among the jinn and mankind
Indeed, We have granted you Al-Kawthar
So pray to your Lord and sacrifice
Indeed, your enemy is the one cut off
By time
Indeed, mankind is in loss

translit: wa tawasaw bil-7aqqi wa tawasaw bil-sabr
translation_en: And advised each other to truth and advised each other to patience
When the victory of Allah has come and the conquest

translit: fa sabbi7 bi7amdi rabbika wa istaghfirhu
translation_en: Then exalt Him with praise of your Lord and ask forgiveness of Him
Indeed, He is ever Accepting of repentance
Did We not expand for you your breast?
And We removed from you your burden
And raised high for you your repute
For indeed, with hardship comes ease
Indeed, with hardship comes ease
So when you have finished your duties, then stand up for worship
And to your Lord direct your longing
By the morning brightness
And by the night when it covers with darkness

translit: ma wadda3aka rabbuka wa ma qala
translation_en: Your Lord has not taken leave of you, nor has He detested you

translit: wa lal-akhiratu khayrun laka mina al-oola
translation_en: And the Hereafter is better for you than the first life
And your Lord is going to give you, and you will be satisfied
Did He not find you an orphan and give shelter?
And He found you lost and guided you
And He found you poor and made you self-sufficient
So as for the orphan, do not oppress him
And as for the petitioner, do not repel him
But as for the favor of your Lord, report it
Indeed, We sent the Quran down during the Night of Decree

translit: wa ma adraka ma laylatu al-qadr
translation_en: And what can make you know what is the Night of Decree?

arabic: لَيْلَةُ ٱلْقَدْرِ خَيْرٌ مِّنْ أَلْفِ شَهْرٍ
arabic_plain: ليلة القدر خير من ألف شهر
translit: laylatu al-qadri khayrun min alfi shahr
translation_en: The Night of Decree is better than a thousand months
The angels and the Spirit descend therein
Peace it is until the emergence of dawn
Recite in the name of your Lord who created
Created man from a clinging substance
Recite, and your Lord is the Most Generous
Who taught by the pen
Taught man that which he knew not
By the fig and the olive
And Mount Sinai
And this secure city (Makkah)

arabic: لَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَانَ فِي أَحْسَنِ تَقْوِيمٍ
arabic_plain: لقد خلقنا الإنسان في أحسن تقويم
translit: laqad khalaqna al-insana fi a7sani taqweem
translation_en: We have certainly created man in the best of stature
Is not Allah the most just of judges?
Exalt the name of your Lord, the Most High
Who created and proportioned
And Who destined and then guided
He has certainly succeeded who purifies himself
And mentions the name of his Lord and prays
This is the Book about which there is no doubt
A guidance for those conscious of Allah

arabic: ٱللَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ٱلْحَيُّ ٱلْقَيُّومُ
arabic_plain: الله لا إله إلا هو الحي القيوم
translit: allahu la ilaha illa huwa al-7ayyu al-qayyoom
translation_en: Allah - there is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of all existence

translit: la ta2khudhuhu sinatun wa la nawm
translation_en: Neither drowsiness overtakes Him nor sleep

arabic: لَّهُ مَا فِي ٱلسَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي ٱلْأَرْضِ
arabic_plain: له ما في السماوات وما في الأرض
translit: lahu ma fi al-samawati wa ma fi al-ard
translation_en: To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth
His Kursi extends over the heavens and the earth

arabic: وَلَا يَؤُودُهُ حِفْظُهُمَا وَهُوَ ٱلْعَلِيُّ ٱلْعَظِيمُ
arabic_plain: ولا يؤوده حفظهما وهو العلي العظيم
translit: wa la ya2ooduhu 7ifzuhuma wa huwa al-3aliyyu al-3azeem
translation_en: And their preservation tires Him not, and He is the Most High, the Most Great
There shall be no compulsion in religion
The right course has become clear from the wrong
Allah is the Ally of those who believe
He brings them out from darknesses into the light

arabic: لَا يُكَلِّفُ ٱللَّهُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا وُسْعَهَا
arabic_plain: لا يكلف الله نفسا إلا وسعها
translit: la yukallifu allahu nafsan illa wus3aha
translation_en: Allah does not charge a soul except with that within its capacity

arabic: رَبَّنَا لَا تُؤَاخِذْنَا إِن نَّسِينَا أَوْ أَخْطَأْنَا
arabic_plain: ربنا لا تؤاخذنا إن نسينا أو أخطأنا
translit: rabbana la tu2akhidhna in naseena aw akhta2na
rabbana la tu'akhidhna in nasina aw a5ta2na
translation_en: Our Lord, do not impose blame upon us if we have forgotten or erred

translit: wa a3fu 3anna wa ighfir lana wa ir7amna
translation_en: And pardon us; and forgive us; and have mercy upon us
Our Lord, give us in this world that which is good

arabic: وَفِي ٱلْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ ٱلنَّارِ
arabic_plain: وفي الآخرة حسنة وقنا عذاب النار
translit: wa fi al-akhirati 7asanatan wa qina 3adhaba al-nar
translation_en: And in the Hereafter that which is good and protect us from the punishment of the Fire

arabic: رَبَّنَا لَا تُزِغْ قُلُوبَنَا بَعْدَ إِذْ هَدَيْتَنَا
arabic_plain: ربنا لا تزغ قلوبنا بعد إذ هديتنا
translit: rabbana la tuzigh quloobana ba3da idh hadaytana
rabbana la tuzi8 qulubana ba3da idh hadaytana
translation_en: Our Lord, let not our hearts deviate after You have guided us

arabic: وَهَبْ لَنَا مِن لَّدُنكَ رَحْمَةً إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلْوَهَّابُ
arabic_plain: وهب لنا من لدنك رحمة إنك أنت الوهاب
translit: wa hab lana min ladunka ra7matan innaka anta al-wahhab
wahab lana min ladunka ra7matan innaka antal-wahhab
translation_en: And grant us from Yourself mercy. Indeed, You are the Bestower
Sufficient for us is Allah, and He is the best Disposer of affairs
My Lord, increase me in knowledge
My Lord, expand for me my breast
And ease for me my task
And untie the knot from my tongue
That they may understand my speech

arabic: لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي كُنتُ مِنَ ٱلظَّالِمِينَ
arabic_plain: لا إله إلا أنت سبحانك إني كنت من الظالمين
translit: la ilaha illa anta sub7anaka innee kuntu mina al-zalimeen
la ilaha illa anta subhanaka inni kuntu minaz-zalimin
translation_en: There is no deity except You; exalted are You. Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers
Our Lord, grant us from Yourself mercy

translit: wa hayyi2 lana min amrina rashada
translation_en: And prepare for us from our affair right guidance
By the wise Quran
Indeed you, O Muhammad, are from among the messengers
Upon a straight path
Peace - a word from a Merciful Lord

arabic: إِنَّمَا أَمْرُهُ إِذَا أَرَادَ شَيْئًا أَن يَقُولَ لَهُ كُن فَيَكُونُ
arabic_plain: إنما أمره إذا أراد شيئا أن يقول له كن فيكون
translit: innama amruhu idha arada shay2an an yaqoola lahu kun fayakoon
innama amruhu idha arada shay'an an yaqula lahu kun fayakun
translation_en: His command is only when He intends a thing that He says to it, Be, and it is

arabic: فَسُبْحَانَ ٱلَّذِي بِيَدِهِ مَلَكُوتُ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ
arabic_plain: فسبحان الذي بيده ملكوت كل شيء وإليه ترجعون
translit: fasub7ana alladhee biyadihi malakootu kulli shay2in wa ilayhi turja3oon
fasub7anal-ladhi biyadihi malakutu kulli shay'in wa ilayhi turja3un
translation_en: So exalted is He in whose hand is the realm of all things, and to Him you will be returned
The Most Merciful taught the Quran
Created man, taught him eloquent expression
So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
Is the reward for good anything but good?

arabic: تَبَارَكَ ٱسْمُ رَبِّكَ ذِي ٱلْجَلَالِ وَٱلْإِكْرَامِ
arabic_plain: تبارك اسم ربك ذي الجلال والإكرام
translit: tabaraka ismu rabbika dhee al-jalali wal-ikram
translation_en: Blessed is the name of your Lord, Owner of Majesty and Honor
Blessed is He in whose hand is dominion
And He is over all things competent

arabic: ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ ٱلْمَوْتَ وَٱلْحَيَاةَ لِيَبْلُوَكُمْ أَيُّكُمْ أَحْسَنُ عَمَلًا
arabic_plain: الذي خلق الموت والحياة ليبلوكم أيكم أحسن عملا
translit: alladhee khalaqa al-mawta wal-7ayata liyabluwakum ayyukum a7sanu 3amala
translation_en: He who created death and life to test you as to which of you is best in deed
Unquestionably, by the remembrance of Allah hearts are assured
Indeed, Allah is with the patient
Indeed, Allah loves the doers of good

arabic: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُحِبُّ ٱلتَّوَّابِينَ وَيُحِبُّ ٱلْمُتَطَهِّرِينَ
arabic_plain: إن الله يحب التوابين ويحب المتطهرين
translit: inna allaha yu7ibbu al-tawwabeena wa yu7ibbu al-mutatahhireen
translation_en: Indeed, Allah loves those who are constantly repentant and loves those who purify themselves

arabic: وَمَن يَتَّقِ ٱللَّهَ يَجْعَل لَّهُ مَخْرَجًا
arabic_plain: ومن يتق الله يجعل له مخرجا
translit: wa man yattaqi allaha yaj3al lahu makhraja
translation_en: And whoever fears Allah - He will make for him a way out
And will provide for him from where he does not expect

arabic: وَمَن يَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ فَهُوَ حَسْبُهُ
arabic_plain: ومن يتوكل على الله فهو حسبه
translation_en: And whoever relies upon Allah - then He is sufficient for him
Allah is the Light of the heavens and the earth
And indeed, you are of a great moral character

translit: wa ma arsalnaka illa ra7matan lil-3alameen
translation_en: And We have not sent you, O Muhammad, except as a mercy to the worlds

arabic: إِنَّ رَحْمَتَ ٱللَّهِ قَرِيبٌ مِّنَ ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
arabic_plain: إن رحمت الله قريب من المحسنين
translit: inna ra7mata allahi qareebun mina al-mu7sineen
translation_en: Indeed, the mercy of Allah is near to the doers of good
Call upon Me; I will respond to you

arabic: فَٱذْكُرُونِي أَذْكُرْكُمْ وَٱشْكُرُوا لِي وَلَا تَكْفُرُونِ
arabic_plain: فاذكروني أذكركم واشكروا لي ولا تكفرون
translit: fadhkuroonee adhkurkum washkuroo lee wa la takfuroon
fadhkuruni adhkurkum washkuru li wala takfurun
translation_en: So remember Me; I will remember you. And be grateful to Me and do not deny Me
If you are grateful, I will surely increase you in favor

arabic: وَقُل رَّبِّ ٱرْحَمْهُمَا كَمَا رَبَّيَانِي صَغِيرًا
arabic_plain: وقل رب ارحمهما كما ربياني صغيرا
translit: wa qul rabbi ir7amhuma kama rabbayanee sagheera
translation_en: And say, My Lord, have mercy upon them as they brought me up when I was small
The believers are but brothers
Indeed, the most noble of you in the sight of Allah is the most righteous of you
And cooperate in righteousness and piety
And speak to people good words

translit: wasbir wa ma sabruka illa billah
translation_en: And be patient, and your patience is not but through Allah

arabic: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يُضِيعُ أَجْرَ ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
arabic_plain: إن الله لا يضيع أجر المحسنين
translit: inna allaha la yudee3u ajra al-mu7sineen
translation_en: Indeed, Allah does not allow to be lost the reward of those who do good

arabic: وَإِذَا سَأَلَكَ عِبَادِي عَنِّي فَإِنِّي قَرِيبٌ
arabic_plain: وإذا سألك عبادي عني فإني قريب
translit: wa idha sa'alaka 3ibadi 3anni fa inni qarib
translation_en: And when My servants ask you concerning Me - indeed I am near
I respond to the invocation of the supplicant when he calls upon Me

arabic: فَلْيَسْتَجِيبُوا لِي وَلْيُؤْمِنُوا بِي لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْشُدُونَ
arabic_plain: فليستجيبوا لي وليؤمنوا بي لعلهم يرشدون
translit: falyastajeeboo lee walyu2minoo bee la3allahum yarshudoon
falyastajibu li walyuminu bi la3allahum yarshudun
translation_en: So let them respond to Me and believe in Me that they may be rightly guided

arabic: قُلْ يَا عِبَادِيَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَسْرَفُوا عَلَىٰ أَنفُسِهِمْ لَا تَقْنَطُوا مِن رَّحْمَةِ ٱللَّهِ
arabic_plain: قل يا عبادي الذين أسرفوا على أنفسهم لا تقنطوا من رحمة الله
translit: qul ya 3ibadiya alladheena asrafoo 3ala anfusihim la taqnatoo min ra7mati allah
qul ya 3ibadiyal-ladhina asrafu 3ala anfusihim la taqnaTu min ra7matillah
translation_en: Say, O My servants who have transgressed against themselves, despair not of the mercy of Allah
Indeed, Allah forgives all sins
Indeed, it is He who is the Forgiving, the Merciful
And those who strive for Us - We will surely guide them to Our ways
And indeed, Allah is with the doers of good

arabic: مَنْ عَمِلَ صَالِحًا مِّن ذَكَرٍ أَوْ أُنثَىٰ وَهُوَ مُؤْمِنٌ فَلَنُحْيِيَنَّهُ حَيَاةً طَيِّبَةً
arabic_plain: من عمل صالحا من ذكر أو أنثى وهو مؤمن فلنحيينه حياة طيبة
translit: man 3amila sali7an min dhakarin aw untha wa huwa mu2minun falanu7yiyannahu 7ayatan tayyibah
man 3amila Salihan min dhakarin aw untha wahuwa muminun falanu7yiyannahu 7ayatan Tayyibah
translation_en: Whoever does righteousness, whether male or female, while a believer - We will surely cause him to live a good life

arabic: وَلَنَجْزِيَنَّهُمْ أَجْرَهُم بِأَحْسَنِ مَا كَانُوا يَعْمَلُونَ
arabic_plain: ولنجزينهم أجرهم بأحسن ما كانوا يعملون
translit: wa lanajziyannahum ajrahum bi-a7sani ma kanoo ya3maloon
walanajziyannahum ajrahum bi-a7sani ma kanu ya3malun
translation_en: And We will surely give them their reward according to the best of what they used to do

arabic: يَا أَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ آمَنُوا ٱسْتَعِينُوا بِٱلصَّبْرِ وَٱلصَّلَاةِ
arabic_plain: يا أيها الذين آمنوا استعينوا بالصبر والصلاة
translit: ya ayyuha alladheena amanoo ista3eenoo bil-sabri wal-salah
ya ayyuhal-ladhina amanu ista3inu bis-Sabri was-salah
translation_en: O you who have believed, seek help through patience and prayer

arabic: يَا أَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ آمَنُوا ٱذْكُرُوا ٱللَّهَ ذِكْرًا كَثِيرًا
arabic_plain: يا أيها الذين آمنوا اذكروا الله ذكرا كثيرا
translit: ya ayyuha alladheena amanoo udhkuroo allaha dhikran katheera
ya ayyuhal-ladhina amanu udhkurullaha dhikran kathiran
translation_en: O you who have believed, remember Allah with much remembrance
And exalt Him morning and afternoon

arabic: هُوَ ٱلَّذِي يُصَلِّي عَلَيْكُمْ وَمَلَائِكَتُهُ لِيُخْرِجَكُم مِّنَ ٱلظُّلُمَاتِ إِلَى ٱلنُّورِ
arabic_plain: هو الذي يصلي عليكم وملائكته ليخرجكم من الظلمات إلى النور
translit: huwa alladhee yusallee 3alaykum wa mala2ikatuhu liyukhrijakum mina al-zulumati ila al-noor
huwal-ladhi yuSalli 3alaykum wamala'ikatuhu liyu5rijakum minaz-zulumati ilan-nur
translation_en: It is He who confers blessing upon you, and His angels ask for His forgiveness for you, that He may bring you out from darknesses into the light
And ever is He, to the believers, Merciful

arabic: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ وَمَلَائِكَتَهُ يُصَلُّونَ عَلَى ٱلنَّبِيِّ
arabic_plain: إن الله وملائكته يصلون على النبي
translit: inna allaha wa mala2ikatahu yusalloona 3ala al-nabiyy
translation_en: Indeed, Allah confers blessing upon the Prophet, and His angels ask Him to do so

arabic: يَا أَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ آمَنُوا صَلُّوا عَلَيْهِ وَسَلِّمُوا تَسْلِيمًا
arabic_plain: يا أيها الذين آمنوا صلوا عليه وسلموا تسليما
translit: ya ayyuha alladheena amanoo salloo 3alayhi wa sallimoo tasleema
ya ayyuhal-ladhina amanu Sallu 3alayhi wasallimu tasliman
translation_en: O you who have believed, ask Allah to confer blessing upon him and ask Allah to grant him peace

arabic: رَبَّنَا تَقَبَّلْ مِنَّا إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
arabic_plain: ربنا تقبل منا إنك أنت السميع العليم
translit: rabbana taqabbal minna innaka anta al-samee3u al-3aleem
translation_en: Our Lord, accept this from us. Indeed You are the Hearing, the Knowing

arabic: وَتُبْ عَلَيْنَا إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلتَّوَّابُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
arabic_plain: وتب علينا إنك أنت التواب الرحيم
translit: wa tub 3alayna innaka anta al-tawwabu al-ra7eem
translation_en: And accept our repentance. Indeed, You are the Accepting of repentance, the Merciful

arabic: رَبِّ ٱجْعَلْنِي مُقِيمَ ٱلصَّلَاةِ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِي
arabic_plain: رب اجعلني مقيم الصلاة ومن ذريتي
translit: rabbi ij3alnee muqeema al-salati wa min dhurriyyatee
translation_en: My Lord, make me an establisher of prayer, and from my descendants
Our Lord, and accept my supplication

arabic: رَبَّنَا ٱغْفِرْ لِي وَلِوَالِدَيَّ وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ يَوْمَ يَقُومُ ٱلْحِسَابُ
arabic_plain: ربنا اغفر لي ولوالدي وللمؤمنين يوم يقوم الحساب
translit: rabbana ighfir lee wa liwalidayya wa lil-mu2mineena yawma yaqoomu al-7isab
rabbanagh-fir li waliwalidayya walil-muminina yawma yaqumul-7isab
translation_en: Our Lord, forgive me and my parents and the believers the Day the account is established

arabic: رَبِّ هَبْ لِي حُكْمًا وَأَلْحِقْنِي بِٱلصَّالِحِينَ
arabic_plain: رب هب لي حكما وألحقني بالصالحين
translit: rabbi hab lee 7ukman wa al7iqnee bil-sali7een
rabbi hab li 7ukman wa al7iqni bis-salihin
translation_en: My Lord, grant me wisdom and join me with the righteous

arabic: وَٱجْعَل لِّي لِسَانَ صِدْقٍ فِي ٱلْآخِرِينَ
arabic_plain: واجعل لي لسان صدق في الآخرين
translit: waj3al lee lisana sidqin fi al-akhireen
translation_en: And grant me a reputation of honor among later generations
And place me among the inheritors of the Garden of Pleasure

arabic: يَوْمَ لَا يَنفَعُ مَالٌ وَلَا بَنُونَ
arabic_plain: يوم لا ينفع مال ولا بنون
translit: yawma la yanfa3u malun wa la banoon
yawma la yanfa3u malun wala banun
translation_en: The Day when neither wealth nor children will be of any benefit

arabic: إِلَّا مَنْ أَتَى ٱللَّهَ بِقَلْبٍ سَلِيمٍ
arabic_plain: إلا من أتى الله بقلب سليم
translit: illa man ata allaha biqalbin saleem
translation_en: Except he who comes to Allah with a sound heart

arabic: هُوَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِي لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ عَالِمُ ٱلْغَيْبِ وَٱلشَّهَادَةِ
arabic_plain: هو الله الذي لا إله إلا هو عالم الغيب والشهادة
translit: huwa allahu alladhee la ilaha illa huwa 3alimu al-ghaybi wal-shahadah
huwallahul-ladhi la ilaha illa huwa 3alimul-8aybi wash-shahadah
translation_en: He is Allah, other than whom there is no deity, Knower of the unseen and the witnessed

arabic: هُوَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْخَالِقُ ٱلْبَارِئُ ٱلْمُصَوِّرُ لَهُ ٱلْأَسْمَاءُ ٱلْحُسْنَىٰ
arabic_plain: هو الله الخالق البارئ المصور له الأسماء الحسنى
translit: huwa allahu al-khaliqu al-bari2u al-musawwiru lahu al-asma2u al-7usna
translation_en: He is Allah, the Creator, the Inventor, the Fashioner; to Him belong the best names

arabic: يُسَبِّحُ لَهُ مَا فِي ٱلسَّمَاوَاتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ
arabic_plain: يسبح له ما في السماوات والأرض وهو العزيز الحكيم
translit: yusabbi7u lahu ma fi al-samawati wal-ardi wa huwa al-3azeezu al-7akeem
yusabbi7u lahu ma fis-samawati wal-ardi wahuwal-3azizul-7akim
translation_en: Whatever is in the heavens and earth exalts Him, and He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise
